# Piyush Lokhande

> Piyush Lokhande is a performance marketing specialist based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. He runs Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads for clinics, hospitals, schools, fashion and retail brands, B2B companies and agencies. He has 5+ years of experience and has managed ₹50L+ in ad spend for 10+ brands in India and the US.

- [Google Ads management in Indore](https://piyushlokhande.in/google-ads-agency-indore.html): Search, local, call and YouTube campaigns with conversion tracking.
- [LinkedIn Ads and B2B lead generation](https://piyushlokhande.in/linkedin-ads-b2b-lead-generation.html): Reaching business owners, buyers and decision-makers for B2B products and services.
- [Hire a remote Meta & Google Ads expert](https://piyushlokhande.in/hire-meta-ads-expert.html): Remote ad management for businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and UAE.
- [White-label PPC for agencies](https://piyushlokhande.in/white-label-ppc-for-agencies.html): Outsourced Meta Ads and Google Ads management for marketing agencies.
- Lead generation funnels, Reels and content strategy, brand and social media management.
